Summary: Canonical relationship provenance and missed-event handling: Broadcom brief says the ownership lookup failed while listing 2 canonical relationships with no filing date
Description: 1) Original intent: a guest can tell which canonical relationships were verified by the current lookup, which were admitted earlier in the same page session, and from which dated SEC filing (CLAUDE.md section 16 no silent absence; rubric item 3 each statement dated and sourced; item 5 one coherent snapshot). Observed 2026-10-10 on build 23b47c8 (localhost, Broadcom): the brief states 'Ownership observation failed (the SEC ownership lookup did not respond) - canonical relationships could not be checked this time' while listing 2 canonical relationships and a full RELATIONSHIP CHANGE section; the relationship lines carry no filing date or accession. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) each canonical relationship line shows its filing date and accession from latestEvidenceFor; (b) when the current ownership lookup errors or times out and relationships already exist, the notice distinguishes the current lookup failure from relationships admitted earlier in the session, with their dates, and never says relationships could not be checked while presenting them as current; (c) useownershiplookup recovers the last known outcome for the subject on mount, so a Brief mounted after krylo-rho-updated fired does not wait for an event it missed; (d) the cause of the missed event stays Unresolved in the ticket until existing evidence establishes it; no rerun is added solely to distinguish the hypotheses (Brief mounted after the event vs a second query in the same page); (e) a regression test covers lookup error with existing relationships, and the Brief mounting after the event; (f) the pending, error and none-admitted states from DEF-1384 and DEF-1392 are unchanged. 3) Current implementation state: relationships are admitted only on the success path of runTargetedOwnershipObservation (secownershipconnector.js, admitAndProject) into an in-memory store (canonicalrelationshipprojection.js); structuralbrief.jsx renders whatever findAdmittedRelationshipsFor returns with no date; the text 'did not respond' is produced only by the 45-second timeout in useownershiplookup.js, which settles only on the krylo-rho-updated event (topicconnectors.js dispatches it, then starts the relationship-change run). 4) Dependencies: useownershiplookup.js, structuralbrief.jsx, structurepanel.jsx (second reader of the hook), canonicalrelationshipprojection.js latestEvidenceFor, topicconnectors.js; related DEF-1384, DEF-1392, KRYL-1389 (snapshot freeze, spec only). Shared-data gate: the hook is read by two components, so the section 2 trace is required before the first edit. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (brief provenance, Direction Honesty, rubric items 3 and 5). Status: filed 2026-10-10 from the Broadcom review; no code changed.
